descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Be the Hero. In Real Life.

The battle is raging on your turf.

Punch, slash, thrust, throw, and bash like a superhero. Dodge, maneuver, disengage, and chase like a hunter. Trust your fighting instincts and unleash the superpowers within. The power is in your body. The arena is in your living room. Pump up your heart rate and stride into battle!

[media]

# Intuitive Powers

Punch, slash, throw. Fight with natural body motions. Your body is the controller, so every move feels instantly intuitive, with plenty of tricks to master. Warning: you might accidentally get a workout.

[media]

# Mixed Reality Movement

Use your actual footwork to close the distance, escape danger, flank your opponent, and take control of the fight. No nausea-inducing joystick sliding. Just stride through your battlefield with momentum.

[media]

# Multiplayer Without Boundaries

Fight friends in the same room or join online matches where superhero avatars teleport into each other's real-world spaces. Distance cannot stop a brawl.

[media]

# Monster Hunt Challenge

Play solo or co-op against waves of ferocious monsters. Keep moving, keep fighting, and do not die.

[media]

# Laugh-Out-Loud Action

Your avatar mirrors your wild moves, from heroic strikes and last-second dodges to silly poses, and victory dances. Every battle can turn into a highlight reel.

[media]

# Early Access, Heroic Future

Launching in Early Access means you can jump in now and help shape the game with your feedback. We are building this together with our players, so suit up and join us on day one!
